notes.title: BIG update & new video
notes.notes:
Hi!

Very happy to be delivering a new public announcement & game play video after all this time.

I have been hard at work on many new features, fixes & optimizations. Hoping to get into early access soon, this summer! I will be pushing this update to the steam beta in a few days.

I am hoping to participate in a few indie events such as the Big Indie Pitch which drew the motivation for making a new video.

Thank you everyone, hope to play with you soon!

Cody

notes.title: October release - New updates with killfeeds, scoreboards, teamplay & better AI
notes.notes:
I've been hard at work on lots of great features, including match scoreboards, killfeeds, teamplay, enhanced AI & more maps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600870/1cd31f9fc0e1e0deea1c6a6ac1f811b1f1933c1f.png[/img]
WIP Scroll-able scoreboard, killfeed, team stock match and new Crazy House arena

My final list for the road to the 1.0 release only includes - some needed optimizations I have already identified, & finishing up with the networking/matchmaking & corresponding matchmaking UI's. 

The game is so much fun to play with bots, I have spent a lot of time practicing with them. I think you'll really like it & I can't wait to play with new people.

Keep posted for the release date and the incoming launch sale!
I also will be posting that gameplay video I promised very soon.

Regards,
Cody
Jamoly Co

notes.title: Pushing for a September EA release, new gameplay video showcasing AI coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35600870/50b7dcafba6e320841daa3393df0f9cf7ba3c523.png[/img]

I've been hard at work trying to get CRAZY CAGE ready for you all! 

There is not much more on my checklist until I can release the first alpha early access version, complete with 4 player split screen, AI bots & multiplayer!

In the meantime I hope to drop a new short gameplay video soon showcasing the AI bots versus the developer. I may have made them too challenging at their default settings.. so who will be the final fighter standing??

Can't wait to get more updates out!

Thank you all for your patience,
Cody
Jamoly Co
